posts.text: Interarch has entered an interesting phase of its growth story. The company is no longer relying only on the traditional pre-engineered building, or PEB, business. Over the last two years, it has been steadily adding manufacturing capacity, and the next leg of growth is expected to come from heavy structural steel, data centres, semiconductor related projects, renewable manufacturing and exports. The numbers are beginning to show the scale of this transition.
